handling: Collect in a compost bin or green waste container.
disposal_guidance: Dispose of in municipal green bins or home compost systems. Do not enclose in plastic bags unless they are certified compostable.
safety_warning: None. Keep covered to avoid attracting pests.

handling: Empty all liquids and lightly rinse.
disposal_guidance: Place in the blue recycling bin. Caps can usually be left on, but check local regulations.

handling: Empty liquids and gently rinse. Do not break the glass.
disposal_guidance: Place in the designated glass recycling bin. Sort by color if required by your municipality.
safety_warning: Handle with care to avoid breakage and cuts.

handling: Factory reset the device to remove personal data before disposal.
disposal_guidance: Take to a certified e-waste recycling center or retail drop-off location. Do NOT throw in regular trash.
safety_warning: Contains heavy metals and a lithium battery. High risk of fire if crushed in a garbage truck.

handling: Store in a cool, dry place. Tape terminals with clear tape to prevent short circuits.
disposal_guidance: DO NOT throw in regular trash or recycling. Take to a designated e-waste drop-off or hazardous waste facility.
safety_warning: High risk of fire if punctured, crushed, or exposed to high heat.

handling: Keep dry and clean. Remove any plastic wrapping or non-paper bindings.
disposal_guidance: Place in the paper recycling bin. If soiled with food or grease, it must go in compost or trash.
